snippet.title: 9th Dawn Remake - Console Launch Trailer - OUT NOW!
snippet.description:
9th Dawn Remake is OUT NOW on Console! You can grab the game on PlayStation, Xbox and Switch on April 24th 2025! The Mobile versions will be released on Google Play and App Store on May 1st 2025!

Xbox: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/9th-dawn-remake/9pf5h31cqp37
PlayStation® : https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10012991
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/9th-dawn-remake-switch/
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1550180/9th_Dawn_Remake/
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.Valorware.NinthDawnRemake 
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/9th-dawn-remake/id6737169079 
-
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/mRQKpb3

We are staggering the Console/Mobile release dates so that I can provide support for any unforeseen issues. The other reason is to help lessen the load on the online server for the optional online co-op mode, to ensure the smoothest online experience possible! Thank you for your patience and understanding!

9th Dawn Remake on console and mobile will include all the content in the Steam version – from monster pets and dungeons to the two mini-games, Fishing Survivors and Deck Rock. The mobile ports for iOS and Android support two players online – console and Steam feature both local and online co-op 🙂

This reimagining of the original 9th Dawn game delivers everything fans have been asking for... and then some! Bring a friend along with online co-op and 2-player local co-op. Explore and do battle in first-person, go (hardcore) fishing, revisit favorite locations (or stumble onto new ones).
